domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers the management of incidents within the ServiceNow platform, focusing on the lifecycle of requests and the application of state flows to track work from creation to closure effectively for all users.

This domain addresses Problem Management processes, ensuring you understand how to handle underlying causes of incidents and manage the associated task workflows effectively within the platform to improve overall service quality for the organization.

This domain focuses on Change and Release Management, covering the procedures for managing changes to the IT environment and the release of new services or updates to ensure system stability and consistent platform performance levels.

This domain covers Service Portfolio Management, which involves managing the collection of services offered by an organization and ensuring they align with business needs and strategic goals for the enterprise and its various stakeholders.

This domain focuses on Service Catalog and Request Management, detailing how to manage user requests, approvals, and the fulfillment process for various service offerings within the ServiceNow platform environment for users and service agents.

This domain covers the Configuration Management Database, focusing on the management of configuration items and their relationships within the ServiceNow service management framework to maintain accurate data and asset tracking for the entire enterprise.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: You will have 90 minutes to complete the 60 questions on this exam. Manage your time effectively across the six domains. Ensure you are familiar with the interface and the specific terminology used in ServiceNow documentation to succeed.

faq.answer_text: The ServiceNow IT Service Management Prep exam consists of 60 questions in total. These questions are distributed across the six domains, with varying weights assigned to each area of the service management framework to test your knowledge of the platform.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: The exam follows a Pass/Fail scoring model. You must demonstrate sufficient knowledge across the tested domains to achieve a passing result on the assessment, ensuring you meet the required standards for certification within the ServiceNow ecosystem.

The exam duration is 90 minutes. You should plan to allocate your time appropriately to address all 60 questions within this period, ensuring you have enough time to review your answers before the timer expires during your session.

For information regarding the long-term certification path or any updates to the exam requirements, please check with ServiceNow directly for the most current details and official guidance on maintaining your professional credentials and status.

methodology.summary: This page was built by synthesizing official ServiceNow exam documentation and verified facts regarding the exam structure, domains, and administrative requirements for the current certification process and standards.

editorial.overview: The ServiceNow IT Service Management Prep exam evaluates your knowledge of core IT service management processes. This assessment covers six key domains, including Incident Management, Problem Management, and Service Catalog and Request Management. It ensures you understand how to manage business functions that require request-type workflows, approvals, and task assignments within the ServiceNow platform environment. This exam validates your technical proficiency in managing service-oriented workflows and platform configurations effectively, ensuring you are prepared to handle complex service management tasks in a professional setting.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the official ServiceNow exam guide and documentation provided in the source links. Focus on understanding the lifecycle of requests and tasks, including how state flows and business rules manage transitions. Practice configuring service management applications and understand the implications of enabling or disabling state flows. Use the provided documentation to familiarize yourself with the specific plugins and configurations required for successful implementation and platform maintenance to ensure you are ready for the 60 questions.
editorial.who_should_take: This exam is for professionals working with ServiceNow IT service management applications. It is suitable for administrators and implementation specialists who manage service requests, state flows, and task assignments within their organization's ServiceNow instance to ensure operational efficiency.
